lcc_original: 她又生了該隱的兄弟亞伯。亞伯是牧羊的，該隱是種地的。
notes: LCC adds the explicit subject pronoun 她 (she/Eve) at the start of the verse — no corresponding SN exists for it in UNV (Hebrew pro-drop), left unannotated.
The two {<WAH0853>} implicit direct object markers (Hebrew את) are retained as implicit since LCC likewise has no explicit Chinese word for them.
LCC uses a comma (，) after 牧羊的 where UNV uses a semicolon (；) — punctuation preserved exactly as in LCC original.
All other lexical items align directly: 又/生了/兄弟/亞伯/是/牧/羊/該隱/是/種/地 map one-to-one with UNV.
